audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Every change is recorded in a tamper-evident, hash-chained log.
audit.noAccessTitle: The audit log isn't available to your role
audit.noAccessBody: Ask an administrator for the audit permission if you need to review activity.
audit.caption: Audit log entries, newest first

filters.label: Audit filters
filters.reversed: The end is before the start.
filters.actorHint: User ID; or click a name below
filters.qHint: Action, entity, actor name or email

verify.title: Chain integrity
verify.desc: Each entry carries a hash of its content and of the entry before it, so a changed or removed entry breaks the chain.
verify.rangeDefault: the last 30 days (set a date range to check another period)
verify.runningBody: Every hash in the range is recomputed on the server. A large log can take a little while.
verify.failedToRunBody: The check did not finish, so nothing is known about the chain. Try again.
verify.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to verify the log.
verify.emptyBody: There are no entries in this range.
verify.okSummary_one: {{formattedCount}} entry checked, chain intact, last hash
verify.okSummary_other: {{formattedCount}} entries checked, chain intact, last hash
verify.brokenHint: Treat this as a security incident: keep the database and its backups as they are and tell your administrator.

reason.prev_hash_mismatch: An entry doesn't link to the previous one.
reason.unknown: The recorded hashes no longer add up.

verify.idle: Not verified yet in this session. Run a check to confirm that nothing has been altered or removed.
verify.entryMissing: Entry #{{chainNo}} is not in the log (it may have been removed).

detail.title: Audit entry
detail.integrityNote: The hash covers this entry and the previous hash. Verifying the chain recomputes it for every entry.

diff.none: No details were recorded for this entry.

export.doneBody: {{size}}. The file starts with a chain-integrity statement.
export.failedBody: The file could not be downloaded. Try again.
export.hint: Exports use the filters above. CSV opens in a spreadsheet; CEF (Common Event Format) is for SIEM tools. Each file starts and ends with a chain-integrity statement.

empty.title: No audit entries yet
empty.body: Changes will appear here as they happen.
empty.filteredBody: Widen the date range or remove a filter.

error.title: Couldn't load the audit log
error.body: Something went wrong while fetching entries.
